changes.text: State: values of another version's state.toml are dropped one by one, the recent folders and tabs kept
Title rows: a long title runs under the buttons, veiled there, in every view - not into them in a narrow panel
GitLab view: merge requests and issues, the branch's last pipeline with run / cancel / retry, job logs in the editor
Cleanup by clippy: the terminal unlocked before laying out its text, UTF-8 checked once on opening a file
Git history: commits not pushed yet in a brighter color of their own - the dot, the subject and the arrow
Git history: the branch and tag labels before the commit's subject
Git history: the subject starts just past its own row's lanes, not the widest row's of the whole history
Git: the repository's name runs under the header's buttons, dimmed there, instead of into them in a narrow side bar
Editor: Ctrl+] / Ctrl+[ indent and outdent the cursor's line (the selected lines), as in VS Code

Git: the history as a graph, as VS Code's - lanes of branches and merges, the server's branch beside ours (its commits not pulled yet in a lane of their own), branch and tag labels at the commits, how the branch stands against the server's above the history
